{{Update |title1 = v1.19.2 |image1 = V1.19Thumb.png |minor_updates = v1.19.2a (27 April 2024)
v1.19.2b (27 April 2024) |release_date = 26 April 2024 |feed_title = Update v1.19.2 |previous_update = [[v1.19.0|Mercenary Base Update]] |next_update = [[v1.20.0|Intermediate Mode Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.19.2''' is the seventy-third update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 26th of April 2024. This update introduced the [[Refund Center]] and a few fixes. This update encompassed three versions, the main v1.19.2 update (released 27 April 2024) and two minor updates, v1.19.2a (released 27 April 2024) and v1.19.2b (released 27 April 2024). ==Additions== :In '''v1.19.2a''' *[[Refund Center]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Trapper]]'s upgrades now use tooltips. *[[Jester]] and [[Trapper]] now display their currently equipped bomb/trap in the bomb/trap selection menu instead of a Roblox bomb gear. *Fixed [[Accelerator]] not being affected by [[Damage Buff]]s. *Fixed [[Tommy Goon 1|Goon2]] and [[Tommy Goon 2|Goon3]] not spawning from the [[Crook Boss]]. *Fixed [[Golden Tommy Goon 1|Golden Goon2]] and [[Golden Tommy Goon 2|Golden Goon3]] not spawning from the [[Golden Crook Boss]]. *Fixed [[Mercenary Base]] [[Damage Buff]] not disappearing from towers after it is sold. *Fixed {{Color|Halloween|Necromancer}} [[Crook Boss]] skin accessories being positioned incorrectly. *Fixed [[Badlands]] appearing in ''Triumph MAP'' quests. *Fixed settings button not being positioned properly. *Fixed mode vote menu sometimes not appearing. *Fixed [[Login Rewards]] not appearing. :In '''v1.19.2b''' *Fixed [[Refund Center]] being disabled due to incorrect timestamps. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V1.19Thumb.png V.1.17.0_UPD_THMBNL.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} MBUpdateIcon2.png }} ==Official Update Log== NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate, as this is transcribed from the in-game update log. Several things may be incorrect, and there may be things that are missing. ===v1.19.2=== {{UpdateLog| {{UpdateBanner|MercenaryBaseThumbnailClean.png|Update v1.19.2}} {{UpdateH1|📜Update Log:}} {{UpdateH3|🛠️ Changes:}} *Added [[Trapper]] tooltip *Fixed setting button not showing up in the correct position *[[Mercenary Base]] [[Damage Buff|damage buff]] now applies on [[Accelerator]] *"Triumph [[Badlands]]" quest will no longer appear *Fixed issue with [[Crook Boss]] goons summon *Fixed [[Crook Boss]] Necromancer skin *Fixed an issue where the vote menu was not appearing *Fixed gift claiming when you already own the item {{UpdateH3|🔥Next Week🔥}} *New Gamemode🧪 {{UpdateThumbnail|PatientZeroIcon.png|...keep an eye on our socials for more info!📢}} }} {{UpdateNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:v1.19.2}} [[Category:Modern Updates]]
